title: Strange and beautiful seabird. Her long slender bare legs were delicate as a crane’s and pure save where an emerald trail of seaweed had fashioned itself as a sign upon the flesh. Her thighs, fuller and soft-hued as ivory, were bared almost to the hips, where the white fringes of her drawers were like feathering of soft white down.
html_source: All of this bird imagery represents Stephen’s new freedom. The girl here is portrayed as a dove which is often associated with innocence, holiness, peace, and purity. Her presence creates a feeling of well-being within Stephen, yet it also creates fear of a loss of control.
